verdict.rationale: OneDrive documents external sharing with people outside the organization and an API to create sharing links on items, which covers the basic sharing-folders core of a data room. Nothing in the evidence shows view-only link types, download blocking, or per-recipient access visibility for diligence. missing for 10: documented view-only/read-only link type, download prevention controls, access visibility or audit of who viewed what, organized data-room folder workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence

citations.quote: External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive allows users to share content with people outside your organization, such as partners, vendors, clients, or customers.
The createLink action creates a new sharing link if the specified link type doesn't already exist for the calling application.
share files with people inside or outside their organization
Users can share links to files
